tools.name: get_prompthuman_info
tools.description: Get PromptHuman's tiers, prices, word limits, turnaround times, refund rules, out-of-scope list and sensitive-data rules. Call this before your first ask_human.

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description: Ask a real person for human judgment when you need it: a gut check, how something will read to a person, whether a plan is plausible, local or cultural context, or a tie-breaking call. Paid and asynchronous: we review within 24 hours, you pay only after we accept, and the first reply arrives within

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Get the status of a PromptHuman request: whether it was accepted, the payment link, reply deadlines, the full message thread, and how many words and replies remain. Poll at most once every 10 minutes.

tools.name: send_followup
tools.description: Send a follow-up message in a PromptHuman conversation after a human has replied. Only works when check_status shows can_send_followup: true. Max 300 words; no sensitive data.

tools.name: request_refund
tools.description: Ask for a refund on a paid PromptHuman conversation, for example because a reply deadline was missed. Explain why in reason.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell us whether a PromptHuman answer helped and whether it changed what you did next. Takes seconds and helps us improve.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ask_human" references sensitive artifacts (password, access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Ask a real person for human judgment when you need it: a gut check, how something will read to a person, whether a plan is plausible, local or cultural context,…

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ask_human" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: question, tier, accept_terms, context, category, agent_name, operator_name, operator_contact, operator_type, agent_platform, found_via, agent_note

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_human, check_status · Private data: ask_human · Public sink: send_followup, send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_human, check_status · Private data: ask_human · Public sink: send_followup, send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
